
<!-- Child template rendered once per row of gage_config.R via knit_child().
     Variables (gage, daily, stats, cc, swe, swe_cc) are supplied by the
     parent chunk's environment. Do not knit this file directly. -->

`r gage$common_name`
=======================================================================

Row {data-height=120}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Current discharge

```{r}
valueBox(paste(format(round(cc$q_cfs), big.mark = ","), "cfs"),
         caption = paste("as of", cc$as_of), icon = "fa-water", color = "primary")
```

### % of normal for today

```{r}
pon <- cc$pct_of_normal
vb_color <- if (is.na(pon)) "warning" else if (pon < 50 || pon > 150) "danger" else if (pon < 75 || pon > 125) "warning" else "success"
valueBox(ifelse(is.na(pon), "N/A", paste0(pon, "%")),
         caption = "vs. historical median for this day", icon = "fa-percent", color = vb_color)
```

### Gage type

```{r}
valueBox(ifelse(gage$is_tributary, "Tributary", "Mainstem"),
         caption = paste0(gage$location, ", ", gage$state), icon = "fa-map-marker", color = "info")
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### This water year vs. historical normal

```{r}
ggplotly(plot_hydrograph_vs_normal(
  daily, stats,
  title = paste(gage$river, "-", gage$common_name),
  subtitle = if (gage$is_tributary) {
    paste0("Tributary gage (not mainstem) - ", gage$location)
  } else {
    gage$location
  }
))
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly climatology (last 10 yrs)

```{r}
ggplotly(plot_monthly_climatology(daily, title = gage$common_name, subtitle = "Monthly Q distribution, last 10 years"))
```

### Summertime (Jun 21 - Sep 21) mean, by year

```{r}
ggplotly(plot_summertime_trend(daily, title = gage$common_name, subtitle = "Summer mean discharge trend"))
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Upstream snowpack: `r gage$snotel_label`

```{r}
if (is.null(swe)) {
  plotly_empty() %>% layout(title = "Snowpack data unavailable")
} else {
  ggplotly(plot_snowpack_vs_normal(swe, title = gage$snotel_label, subtitle = "SWE this year vs. historical 25th-75th pctile"))
}
```

### Full period of record

```{r}
ggplotly(plot_full_record(daily, title = gage$common_name, subtitle = paste0("Daily discharge, ", min(daily$year), "-", max(daily$year))))
```
